alternatives.name: Mem0
alternatives.why_not_default: Application memory and temporal retrieval are source-supported, but retained evidence does not demonstrate native cross-client capture, recovery or improved project recall on a matched workload.

alternatives.name: Letta Code
alternatives.why_not_default: Its stateful harness entails a broader runtime migration. Native Codex/Claude continuity, account boundaries and restored project memory have not been demonstrated for that replacement.

alternatives.name: OpenViking
alternatives.why_not_default: Inspectable hierarchical context is relevant, but no retained execution establishes improved handoffs, capture, deletion or recovery across the selected native clients.

alternatives.name: Graphiti
alternatives.why_not_default: Temporal relationships could complement project memory, but extraction provenance, scoped updates and restoration remain unqualified on this workload. No measured project-continuity advantage establishes a replacement.

alternatives.name: Cognee
alternatives.why_not_default: Graph/context assembly and local processing are plausible capabilities. The selected provider profile, native capture, project isolation and recovery lack retained execution acceptance.

alternatives.name: Supermemory
alternatives.why_not_default: Local and offline routes prevent a cloud-only exclusion, but provider behavior, export/restore, isolation and representative cross-client retrieval remain unqualified.

alternatives.name: Basic Memory
alternatives.why_not_default: The retained synthetic native CLI comparison passed lexical retrieval, overwrite, deletion and index rebuilding. It exercised neither agent hooks nor real cross-client handoffs; rebuilding an index did not establish loss-of-database restoration. These results establish eligibility, not superiority over ai-memory's broader native continuity evidence.

limits: This verdict reviews retained execution; no new native client, model, installation or memory benchmark was run.
All eight adopted candidates' pinned README bytes were fetched and matched the retained source hashes. This verifies source identity, not runtime behavior.
Private transcripts, original backup archives and production state were not inspected; recovery conclusions retain the published receipts' boundaries.
The existing lexical comparison has unequal recovery operations and cannot establish comparable latency, semantic quality or complete provider cost.
open_gaps: Useful autonomous learning remains unestablished: the retained real-session review rejected insufficient durable evidence, and scheduler admission produced no learned edits.
Representative semantic recall, decision accuracy, handoff usefulness and complete provider consumption have no matched comparison.
Capture is bounded and sanitized; it does not establish complete transcript retention or universal current-session coverage.
TTL controls default search visibility until sweep; deletion observations do not establish erasure from historical versions, logs or backups.
Same-host restored SQLite/FTS state does not establish live-client rebinding, atomic database/wiki consistency or independent disaster recovery.
The reviewed ai-memory upstream revision is not the accepted installed 2.3.2 revision; upgrade behavior remains unqualified.
The synthetic ai-memory comparison initially attempted an unwanted model download. The corrected explicit embedding opt-out passed, but network bytes were not measured.

arms: Basic Memory 0.23.2 at the retained source pin in an isolated project
overturn_protocol.metric: Preserve the frozen lexical facts, overwrite and deletion checks, then compare source-grounded recall and real Codex/Claude handoffs with equivalent capture, isolation and empty-target restore checks. Require improved usefulness or complete measured cost without lifecycle regressions; the existing synthetic results alone are insufficient.

overturn_when: Change the verdict after a fresh executed comparison extending blueprints/memory-lifecycle-probe/corpus.json and blueprints/blind-catalog-convergence/memory-experiment.json demonstrates better source-grounded recall or handoff usefulness while matching native capture, deletion, isolation and empty-target recovery. Rechecking blueprints/memory-lifecycle-probe/verify.py alone cannot promote a challenger.
why_selected: Select ai-memory as the best-supported operational fit. docs/native-memory-rag-lifecycle.md records actual native Codex retrieval and a fresh Claude memory call; evidence/artifacts/memory-rag-lifecycle-20260921/native-client.json records exact stored-final readback and completed consolidation. blueprints/us-equities/memory-lifecycle/receipt.json separately records synthetic native routing, TTL and deletion checks. blueprints/us-equities/state-recovery/memory/receipt.json records native backup and isolated same-host restoration with SQLite/FTS verification. Together these cover more of the required cross-client continuity and inspectable lifecycle than the alternatives. They do not establish superior semantic recall or useful learned writes.
